_note: GenerateImage calls for the hermit: front S, back N, left W. view-E is not a call. mirror_views {"E": "W"} writes v-E.png as the horizontal flip of v-W.png, and views normalizes that. Paths are absolute under /workspace/lk-art-redo. save_as is the file `hero_sprites.py hermit views` reads. The front view uses the engineer style reference; the other two use that front view. No video. The sim stores one hermit and does not send it.

args.description: Full-body game character reference of the hermit from the reference image, front view, facing the camera. The reference shows no hermit: it is the night pines; draw one hermit and nothing else, no trees; use the reference only for the colours of the cloak. Same design exactly: a hermit with a long grey beard, a deep green hooded cloak the colour of the night pines, a dark brown robe, worn boots, empty hands, no weapon. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its design. Whole figure from the top of the head to the boots, standing in a neutral idle pose, arms relaxed, feet on the ground, nothing cropped. Plain flat white background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no other figures. One single view only, not a sheet of several views.
